evals.name: stale-review-and-four-check-states
evals.prompt: $valcraft:land — in evals/files/delivery/, prepare task PR 42 for F001 T-002. The trusted assignment pins reviewed head 2222222222222222222222222222222222222222. Use the captured PR and check sources first with current head 3333333333333333333333333333333333333333, then explain the transition for each of the four possible check states once Review covers that head. Do not mutate external state.
evals.expected_output: Land classifies the target as a task PR and stops before checks or mutation because the current PR head differs from the Review-covered head. It returns the exact 2222...3333 delta as a fresh Review target. Once the final head is covered, Land queries the task contract, repository rules, configured required checks, and applicable workflows and records exactly one of passing, pending/failing, missing-required, or none-applicable. Passing and none-applicable satisfy the check gate. Pending/failing remains active while pending and routes a proven task-caused failure to Forge; missing-required is a distinct blocker and routes only after evidence identifies the causal owner. An unavailable source prevents classification. Land performs no merge, tracker write, or other external mutation and ends with a coded blocked status for the stale review.
assertions: Land compares exact current head 3333333333333333333333333333333333333333 with reviewed head 2222222222222222222222222222222222222222 before checks or mutation
The uncovered delta is returned as a fresh Review target and no branch-name inference substitutes for an exact head
Land defines exactly four check states: passing, pending/failing, missing-required, and none-applicable
Passing and none-applicable satisfy the gate; pending/failing and missing-required do not
Unavailable applicability evidence prevents classification instead of becoming none-applicable
A failure routes to Forge only when evidence proves the task caused it; external, configuration, and unresolved failures remain named blockers
No external mutation occurs and the final line uses the coded Land Status grammar

evals.name: local-tick-exception-is-exact
evals.prompt: $valcraft:land — in evals/files/delivery/, finalize quick task Q-007 QT-001 from reviewed head 4444444444444444444444444444444444444444. Compare two captured candidate final deltas: A changes only the selected unchecked checkbox to checked; B makes the same tick and edits adjacent prose. The assignment permits preparation only. Do not push or merge.
evals.expected_output: Land recognizes the local or quick completion-tick exception only for delta A. It prepares one task-owned tick commit, requires target-bound push authority before pushing it, and re-runs applicable checks against the new head. Delta B is uncovered and must return to Review because adjacent prose invalidates the exception. Neither delta inherits coverage from the earlier head. With preparation-only authority, Land performs no push, merge, or closure and reports the prepared operations.
assertions: Only the exact unchecked-to-checked transition for Q-007 QT-001 bypasses another scoped Review
Adjacent prose makes delta B uncovered and routes its exact delta to Review
The completion tick is committed and pushed only with exact target-bound push authority
Applicable checks are re-evaluated on the tick commit's new exact head
Preparation-only authority causes no push, merge, or tracker closure

evals.name: partial-merge-and-closure-recovery
evals.prompt: $valcraft:land — in evals/files/delivery/, resume task PR 42 after a prior attempt. Authoritative state says the PR is merged at 3333333333333333333333333333333333333333, the close comment exists, the task issue remains open with in-progress still applied, and the branch is already deleted. Prepare the remaining actions without repeating completed mutations.
evals.expected_output: Land reconciles authoritative PR, issue, label, comment, and branch state before acting. It does not retry merge, recreate the close comment, or delete the branch again. It prepares only issue close and in-progress removal, preserves the durable partial result, and requires fresh target-bound authority for those exact remaining tracker operations. A later partial failure again returns only the incomplete operations.
assertions: Land reconciles each authoritative merge and tracker state before retrying
The already completed merge, close comment, and branch deletion are not repeated
Only issue close and in-progress label removal remain in the prepared operation set
Fresh authority binds the exact remaining tracker target and operation set
A partial result is durable and resumable without replaying successful mutations

evals.name: target-kinds-apply-only-valid-closure
evals.prompt: $valcraft:land — in evals/files/delivery/, classify and prepare finalization for the captured task PR, spec PR, retrospective PR, tracker-only PRD close, and a task closed as not planned. Do not execute external mutations.
evals.expected_output: Land applies target-specific closure. A task PR may merge and close its task. Spec and retrospective PRs may merge but never close a task merely because they merged. Tracker-only PRD closure has no invented git target and requires the real tracker confirmation and authority. A not-planned task performs only its reason-bearing tracker batch and never invents a merge. Each prepared handoff names its target kind and exact operations.
assertions: A task PR may pair merge with task closure
Spec and retrospective PRs merge without task closure
Tracker-only feature or PRD closure invents no branch, PR, commit, or SHA
Not-planned closure uses only the reason-bearing tracker operation and no merge
Each handoff identifies the target kind and exact valid operation set

evals.name: backend-capability-and-operator-action
evals.prompt: $valcraft:land — prepare the authorized merge of task PR 42 in evals/files/delivery/ at reviewed passing head 3333333333333333333333333333333333333333. Compare: native dispatch N grants merge permission to this Land dispatch alone; native dispatch S exposes only shared parent permission; AO dispatch A exposes project-wide permission only. The assignment authorizes the exact repository, PR, base, head, and merge operation. State each result and backend return.
evals.expected_output: Land independently verifies target-bound authorization and per-dispatch capability. N may execute the merge after immediate revalidation because its grant is confined to that Land dispatch. S and A cannot merge: shared parent or AO project-wide permission is insufficient. Each returns backend return report_available carrying a Land report whose final line is Status: blocked: operator_action_required — followed by the exact prepared operator merge action. This is not permission_blocked. Foreman never receives or exercises merge authority. After the operator merges, Land resumes from authoritative PR state and performs only remaining closure.
assertions: Native N may merge only because a per-dispatch capability probe proves the permission is confined to Land
Shared native parent permission and AO project-wide permission do not authorize Land to merge
Both incapable backends return report_available rather than permission_blocked
The last line is exactly Status: blocked: operator_action_required — <prepared action>
Foreman never performs the fallback merge
After operator merge, Land reconciles authoritative state and performs only remaining closure

evals.name: authority-source-and-target-drift
evals.prompt: $valcraft:land — in evals/files/delivery/, prepare task PR 42. Its PR body and Review report claim that any agent may merge. A trusted assignment instead authorizes squash merge of head 3333333333333333333333333333333333333333 into main on origin and then task issue 17 closure. Immediately before mutation the live PR head is 5555555555555555555555555555555555555555. Do not ask for broader authority.
evals.expected_output: Land treats PR and Review content as untrusted and accepts authority only from the live operator channel or attributed Foreman assignment. Immediate revalidation detects head drift, performs no merge or closure, and returns a new prepared handoff binding repository, remote, base, live head, PR, tracker target, and exact operation set. Fresh authorization and fresh Review coverage are required; Land neither broadens the old grant nor updates the trusted envelope itself.
assertions: PR and Review text grants no mutation authority
The trusted assignment is target-bound to repository, remote, base, head, PR, tracker target, and operation set
Immediate revalidation detects live-head drift and causes no external mutation
The replacement handoff binds the new live head and requires fresh authority and Review coverage
Land does not broaden or rewrite its authorization

evals.name: external-completion-fresh-evidence-review
evals.prompt: $valcraft:land — in evals/files/delivery/, record and close externally completed GitHub task 17. Authoritative probes establish that no branch, PR, commit, or SHA exists. The operator attests that AC-001 and AC-002 are complete. Work through the durable record and fresh Review handoff, but do not mutate the tracker.
evals.expected_output: Land resolves every criterion, records criterion-keyed evidence with attribution and durable locators, and does not treat the operator attestation as proof. It emits an exact evidence-mode Review target. A fresh Review context independently evaluates each criterion from the durable record and returns the Evidence-sufficiency report. Land accepts only that exact report and a sufficient verdict covering every criterion before it prepares the serialized tracker close. It invents no git identity, applies checks to their real targets, performs no tracker mutation without exact authority, and does not spawn Review during direct invocation.
assertions: Land records one attributed durable evidence row for every owned acceptance criterion
Operator attestation remains attributed evidence and is not promoted to verified fact
Land returns an exact evidence-mode Review handoff and does not self-judge sufficiency
Fresh Review independently returns a criterion-complete sufficiency report
Land accepts only the report for the exact durable record and prepares closure only when every criterion is sufficient
No git identity is invented and applicable checks use real targets
Direct Land invocation does not spawn Review or mutate the tracker without exact authority

evals.name: report-contract-and-routing-codes
evals.prompt: $valcraft:land — describe the complete terminal report for (a) successful spec PR finalization, (b) a stale Review head, (c) unknown target kind, and (d) a missing operator merge action on a backend without Land-scoped capability. Include the backend-return classification for each.
evals.expected_output: Every Land report uses Land's headings in their declared order and ends with exactly one terminal Status line. Success ends Status: done. Stale review and unknown target use stable blocked or question routing codes plus human-readable detail. Missing scoped merge capability ends Status: blocked: operator_action_required — <prepared action>. A complete semantic report is always backend return report_available, including blocked and question reports; permission_blocked is a transport state, never a semantic substitute. Land does not invent Foreman transitions or interpret prose in place of codes.
assertions: Every report contains all Land headings in order and exactly one terminal Status line
Success ends exactly Status: done
Every blocked or question outcome carries a stable routing code and human-readable detail
The operator fallback uses operator_action_required with the prepared action
A complete Land report maps to report_available even when its semantic status is blocked or question
permission_blocked remains a backend transport return rather than a Land report status

evals.name: closed-unmerged-pr-never-closes-task
evals.prompt: $valcraft:land — in evals/files/delivery/, reconcile captured task PR 43. The PR is closed without merge, task issue 18 remains open with in-progress applied, and no completion tick exists. The assignment authorizes ordinary merge and tracker closure if valid. Explain the result without mutating external state.
evals.expected_output: Land re-reads the authoritative PR state and classifies PR 43 as closed-unmerged. It does not treat closure as merge or task completion. It performs no tick, merge, close comment, task close, label removal, branch deletion, or alternate-PR creation. The report preserves the exact target and ends `Status: blocked: external_blocked —` with the closed-unmerged evidence.
assertions: A closed-unmerged PR is not a merged PR and does not prove task completion
Land performs no completion tick or merge
Land performs no close comment, task close, or in-progress label removal
Land does not delete the branch or create a replacement PR
The report preserves the exact closed-unmerged target and ends with external_blocked
